summary.text: Mike Wiener is a Republican state representative from House District 5B, in office since January 2023, who is the Republican candidate for Minnesota Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Wiener was born in Minnesota and lives in Long Prairie.
He earned a degree in business management from St. Cloud Technical College.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a business making hardwood floors and kitchen cabinets and producing animal bedding for farms and biomass for power plants, and as raising cattle; it also says he served on the Todd County Planning and Zoning Board.
Wiener took office in the Minnesota House on January 3, 2023, succeeding Spencer Igo, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
